scope: Local macOS ARM64 reproduction only: exact released daemon source, actual worker scheduler/SQLite/loopback HTTP callbacks; synthetic WebSocket read-ACK response held in a channel. No live IAM, production calls, release mutation or hardware changes.
cause: A second delivery notification wakes workers while the hook already has an active forward job waiting for its first read ACK. Workers consumes the wake and skips the active hook. The completed job does not wake workers, so the second eligible batch waits for another notification or the one-second timer.

baseline.interpretation: Two deterministic reproductions of a scheduling delay; not an end-to-end production benchmark or percentile.

candidate.status: Isolated demonstration for a future native patch only; not shipped
candidate.change: Observe worker completion and reconsider queued work after successful forwarding; match the completed task ID, retain backoff, and skip empty queues so the scheduler cannot spin on empty forwards.
candidate.limits: Demonstrates this specific race on macOS ARM64. A future patch still needs normal release review, cross-platform CI and real short-burst verification. These measurements do not predict a new 318 ms first-callback result.

benchmark_gap: The old regional benchmark spaced sends three seconds apart, excluding this overlapping-job case. Backend 0.1.2 fixes a separate server notification race; it does not change the immutable native 0.1.2 daemon.
replay_requirements: Run from the repository root with Rust/Cargo and patch available; offline dependencies must already be cached. Uses an independent temporary package/target and deletes it after completion. Baseline failure is expected; candidate must pass.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess, tempfile
root = Path.cwd()
report = json.loads((root / "deploy/daemon-burst-latency-analysis.json").read_text())
source = (root / "crates/ting-daemon/src/main.rs").read_text()
assert hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest() == report["source_sha256"]["crates/ting-daemon/src/main.rs"], "Source changed; reproduce against recorded release source"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ting-burst-replay-") as directory:
    scratch = Path(directory)
    (scratch / "src").mkdir()
    manifest = (root / "crates/ting-daemon/Cargo.toml").read_text()
    manifest = manifest.replace('name = "silicon-ting-daemon"', 'name = "ting-burst-reproduction"')
    manifest = manifest.replace('path = "../ting-client"', f'path = "{root}/crates/ting-client"')
    manifest = manifest.replace('readme = "../../README.md"', f'readme = "{root}/README.md"')
    (scratch / "Cargo.toml").write_text(manifest + "\n[workspace]\n")
    (scratch / "Cargo.lock").write_text((root / "Cargo.lock").read_text().replace('name = "silicon-ting-daemon"', 'name = "ting-burst-reproduction"'))
    (scratch / "src/main.rs").write_text(source + report["fixture_rust"])
    command = ["cargo", "test", "--offline", "--manifest-path", str(scratch / "Cargo.toml")]
    baseline = subprocess.run(command + ["burst_reproduction", "--", "--nocapture"])
    assert baseline.returncode == 101, "Baseline should fail the 500 ms callback deadline"
    subprocess.run(["patch", "-p1"], cwd=scratch, input=report["candidate_patch"], text=True, check=True)
    subprocess.run(command + ["--", "--nocapture"], check=True)
